configuration.behavior: Use a secure channel when a CA path is configured; fail closed if server TLS is configured without a CA path; retain insecure private-development behavior only when neither TLS nor CA is configured.
configuration.secret_material: Compose passes paths only and does not mount or ship certificate material.

transport_behavior.explicit_ca: Reads the CA bundle and uses grpc.secure_channel.
transport_behavior.environment_ca: GRPC_TLS_CA selects grpc.secure_channel when server TLS is configured.
transport_behavior.missing_ca: Configured server TLS without a CA path fails before opening any channel.
transport_behavior.missing_trust_file: Returns a fixed redacted error without exposing the configured path or opening a channel.
transport_behavior.cleanup: The health channel is closed after the mocked RPC completes.

limitations: Transport and certificate handling were verified with mocks; no live TLS handshake or hostname validation was performed.
Production certificate mounting/rotation, public ingress, authenticated tenant scope, and REST parity remain open.
